description: Order a formatted, downloadable financial report (Excel or PDF) for a Norwegian company — the same multi-source-fused figures, layout and source note as the report a customer would download in the Firmaradar portal, ready to file or forward. Returns a short-lived download link + metadata (years covered, source, currency), NOT the file itself and NOT base64 data — fetch the download_url separately, no further auth required, within expires_in seconds. Use `get_company_financials` instead when you need the raw figures to reason about, not a document to hand off. Requires the Excel-export or PDF-export add-on (matching the requested format) on the caller's account. Charges 1 credit per financial year included in the report.

format.description: 'xlsx' for a spreadsheet (3 sheets: figures, key ratios, source) or 'pdf' for a print-ready report. Each format requires its own subscription add-on on the caller's account (Excel export / PDF export respectively) — a 403 'extension_not_active' error means that add-on isn't enabled.
format.title: Format

regnskapstype.description: 'SELSKAP' for the standalone company accounts, 'KONSERN' for the consolidated group accounts (only meaningful for companies that file one).
regnskapstype.title: Regnskapstype

years.description: Number of financial years to include (hard-capped at 5).
years.title: Years

name: firmaradar_get_regnskapsrapport

aar.description: The financial years included, newest first.
aar.title: Aar

antall_aar.description: Number of years actually delivered in the report.
antall_aar.title: Antall Aar

download_url.description: Short-lived signed URL (~15 min) for the actual file. No further authentication is required to fetch it — the URL itself is the credential, so treat it as sensitive and don't share it beyond the requester.
download_url.title: Download Url

kilde.description: Source label shown in the report.
kilde.title: Kilde

valuta.description: Reporting currency (ISO 4217, or 'MIXED' if it changed within the series).
valuta.title: Valuta
